blocks.text: Lots and land in Cape Horn

items.t: Lot character from the zone minimums, as stated: small-scale residential zones R-1, R-2 and R-3 under Zoning Bylaw No. 3000, 1996 — minimum lot size for subdivision is 650 m² with 18.5 m width for R-1 and R-3, and 465 m² with 12.5 m width for R-2. These are zone minimums, not a claim about any existing lot's size; the zone and dimensions of a specific lot are confirmed parcel by parcel.

Serviced position: Coquitlam's SSMUH rules as adopted exclude lots not connected to municipal water or sewer — so a lot's connection status decides its added-unit potential, and property-level septic or well status is not verified. Coquitlam utility charges cover water, sewer and drainage and solid waste. Confirm servicing for the specific parcel with the City.

ALR vs non-ALR: ALR status for the sub-area is not verified; ALR status for a specific property is checked in the Agricultural Land Commission's ALR Property and Map Finder. No ALR percentage split is stated.

Slope and watercourse diligence: the Watercourse Protection Development Permit Area covers all areas within 30 metres of the top of bank or top of ravine bank of any watercourse in this part of Coquitlam; Zoning Bylaw s.519 sets flood protection setbacks from watercourses and s.523 covers riparian areas. Slope / geotechnical status for a specific lot: Not verified.

Crescentview Townhomes — 2665 Cape Horn Avenue. TENURE not confirmed, never counted: a rental directory describes an 82-house, 2-storey community built in 1982 presented through a leasing office; whether it is strata-titled, purpose-built rental or a mix is not confirmed on the sources checked, and on the only sources available it presents as rental — establish tenure on a title/strata source before treating any home there as purchasable.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Cape Horn

items.t: Cape Horn is the established residential slope in south Coquitlam above the Cape Horn interchange, where Highway 1, Lougheed Highway (Highway 7) and the Mary Hill Bypass (Highway 7B) meet at the Port Mann Bridge approach; the City tracks the area as planning areas 15 and 16 in its development statistics. "Cape Horn" is the GVR sub-area name in the SnapStats GVR September 2026 report. Boundaries: Not verified — no City neighbourhood plan boundary is stated on a City page in the sources read; the working description is the slope above the interchange, below Austin Avenue / Mariner Way.

Nearby areas: Maillardville and Coquitlam West west and north-west, Central Coquitlam north up Mariner Way, Port Coquitlam east across the Coquitlam River / Mary Hill Bypass, Surrey south across the Port Mann Bridge.

Main roads: Mariner Way and Cape Horn Avenue are the residential roads connecting the slope to the interchange; United Boulevard below the slope is a light-industrial and commercial road. Transit: the nearest SkyTrain stations are Braid, Lougheed Town Centre and Burquitlam — none inside the sub-area; bus routes serving the interior streets: Not verified. Commute times in minutes: Not verified — do not quote drive-time marketing claims for this interchange.

Civic anchors: no park or recreation facility inside Cape Horn was confirmed on a City source — Mackin Park and the Poirier Sport & Leisure Complex serve the south-west side from Maillardville. Nearest library: Coquitlam Public Library Poirier branch, 575 Poirier Street. Nearest hospital: Eagle Ridge Hospital, 475 Guildford Way, Port Moody.

Market context, labelled correctly: Coquitlam is a SnapStats-covered community and SnapStats has no land category. September 2026 context only, never land figures: Cape Horn sub-area detached inventory 18 / solds 2 (11% ratio) and "Condos & Townhomes" combined 13 / 0 (ratio not applicable); Coquitlam community detached median $1,455,000 and attached median $625,000. Sub-area medians are not verified (community level only).

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Cape Horn

items.t: Zoning — City of Coquitlam Zoning Bylaw No. 3000, 1996: the small-scale residential zones on the slope are R-1, R-2 and R-3, with the subdivision minimums in. Confirm the parcel's zone on the City's zoning maps.

Infrastructure diligence — Coquitlam Water Main, Cape Horn Section: Metro Vancouver is constructing the Coquitlam Water Main (approximately 12 km in four sections); the Cape Horn Section is approximately 4 km long and 2.2 m in diameter, running from Westwood Street and Dewdney Trunk Road to Hickey Drive and Mariner Way, including a trenchless tunnel crossing under Lougheed Highway — construction on the Mariner Way corridor is a live diligence item for slope addresses.

ALR rules (for completeness — no Cape Horn ALR parcel is confirmed here): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Farm class is three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an error.

blocks.text: Good to know about Cape Horn

items.t: The City's own numbers describe a house-lot area, not a development frontier: planning areas 15/16 created 36 homes and demolished 18 in the 2022 statistics year — every created unit in single-family, suite or carriage-house form, zero townhouse or apartment units. Land value here is replacement and added-unit value on existing lots.
A strata seller here cannot price off a sub-area sold that does not exist; the Coquitlam community attached median was $625,000.

A 2.2-metre water main is being tunnelled under the highway below these lots: the Cape Horn Section includes a trenchless tunnel crossing under Lougheed Highway — infrastructure most buyers never hear about until a Mariner Way showing lands in a construction window.

The floodplain engineering at Fraser Mills does not describe the slope: Debut's site was preloaded to stand 20 feet above median sea level on the Fraser River floodplain — a waterfront-site fact. Slope lots carry the opposite diligence: ravine, watercourse and geotechnical checks.

faq.q: Is there a vacant lot subdivision on the Cape Horn slope?
faq.a: No verified one — the slope is an established detached-house area whose 2022 City permit record is entirely single-family / suite / carriage-house form. Land trades as built house lots.

faq.q: Can a Cape Horn house lot add units?
faq.a: Yes under the City's SSMUH rules — up to 3 units on lots 280 m² or smaller and up to 4 units on lots under 4,050 m², including secondary suites and carriage or laneway homes — but lots not connected to municipal water or sewer fall outside the rules, so confirm services and the exact zone first.

faq.q: Is Fraser Mills a land purchase?
faq.a: No — it is a presale strata development below the slope (Debut, Encore, Chapter by Beedie Living) filed under Cape Horn by listing sources.

faq.q: Can I buy a home at Crescentview on Cape Horn Avenue?
faq.a: Tenure first: the only sources checked present it as a rental community and its strata/rental status is not confirmed — establish tenure on a title or strata source before treating any home there as purchasable.

faq.q: What does the water main mean for a Mariner Way lot?
faq.a: Metro Vancouver's Cape Horn Section runs to Hickey Drive and Mariner Way with a tunnel crossing under Lougheed Highway — confirm the construction window and any shaft locations against the specific address before closing.

faq.q: What is Cape Horn named for?
faq.a: The Cape Horn interchange below the slope, where Highway 1, Lougheed Highway (Highway 7), the Mary Hill Bypass (Highway 7B) and United Boulevard meet at the Port Mann Bridge approach; the City tracks the area as planning areas 15 and 16.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Cape Horn address?
faq.a: School District 43 (Coquitlam), with address-based catchments. No Cape Horn address-level catchment is verified in this file — the recorded locator run used 575 Poirier Street, outside the sub-area — so check the exact address in the SD43 locator.
